question.worked_solution:
To evaluate ${700}^{2},$ we start by writing it out with a multiplication sign:

$$
{700}^{2}={{700\times 700}_{⏟}}_{2\text{ times}}
$$

Then, we work out $700\times 700.$

First, we figure out the non-zero part and the block of zeros for both numbers:

$$
\begin{aligned}700 & \,⟶\,700 \\ 700 & \,⟶\,700\end{aligned}
$$

We can see that there are $4$ zeros in total.

Next, we multiply the non-zero parts:

$$
7\times 7=49
$$

Finally, we join the above with the block of zeros: 

$$
490000=490,000
$$

Therefore, ${700}^{2}=490,000.$
